lines: Just thisness — Your form, power-juiced; where sequence fails,
time-reckoning melts by force. By mind, speech, senses, pots — may I stand that form at once, unceasing.
l4.sanskrit_cite: idantāvad rūpaṃ tava bhagavataḥ śaktisarasaṃ | tadrūpaṃ yugapad adhitiṣṭheyam aniśam

verses.craft: Thisness-force; sequenceless melts time; all-instruments-at-once; idantāvat per UNC.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['idantāvat force kept.']) / C1 essence / rasa vīra of standing / L2+L3 voice (handcrafted, restored)
